segments.text: 14 In the decree of the watchmen is the ſentence, and in the word of the holy ones is the requeſt: to ye intent that the liuing mē may know, that the moſt hygh hath power ouer the kingdome of men, and geueth it to whom ſo euer he will, and appoynteth ouer it the moſt abiect among men.
